subject: Three clean grey landers on the dun Barrens flats beside the colony pad; a hundred armed people in grey filing down a ramp; a figure at the ramp foot reading from a paper; the weathered colonists watching.
notes: Barrens Part 3. Screenprint light. Barrens' own dun and red ground. Never show the Mocker itself: only what it leaves and who sees it.
